text.aria-label: Subtitle text '16 Primary substations, 292 daily forecast runs, July 2025 to June 2026. Scored on half- hours outside labelled switching and logged closures. Dot: estimate. Line: 98.33% interval from re-drawing whole months. Zero: same score. Dashed line: +0.02, the harm the masked arm may show and still be adopted.'
